messages:
Omar: spun up a quick UX pass for Compliance > Retention & Keys. Screenshot + notes in the doc.
Tess: looked — a few distinct nits that came up from the field: retention placement, ambiguous KMS label, and audit log wording.
Ravi: can you list the concrete copy/UI asks? i'll update the mock.
Omar: 1) retention control gets pushed down on narrow widths. Suggest a compact row: Region | Retention (inline value) | KMS badge. 2) label: 'Retention (days)' is ok but we tested 'Automatically remove after' and customers preferred it.
Tess: prefer shorter: 'Automatically remove after' vs 'Auto-delete after' felt slightly softer in user interviews.
Marta: microcopy for helper: propose 'Data will be permanently removed after the selected period. Exported copies for legal requests may persist per policy.' link to policy in 'Learn more'.
Ravi: good. UI idea: show a tiny 'Retention preview' under the selector that estimates rows and storage: '~1.2k items (~48MB) will be deleted at next purge' — helps customers understand impact.
Tess: nice idea, we should grey that text and make it optional behind a feature flag.
Omar: 3) KMS wording: current badge 'Customer key' -> replace with 'BYOK — Customer-managed key'. Hover tooltip: 'You hold the key. Redwood does not have access to key material.'
Marta: accessibility: add SR-only text when toggled: 'Using customer-managed key. Redwood has no key access.' Also lock icon needs contrast bump; current ratio 2.1:1 per access-bot.
access-bot: a11y check: lock-icon contrast ratio 2.1:1 (fail). Recommend icon color #0F2433 or add explicit text label next to icon.
Ravi: will update icon and add text label option.
Tess: 4) audit log: event names are raw (e.g., `data.exported_for_compliance`, `kms.key_rotated`). Request: show friendly event titles in list and keep raw type in details JSON.
Omar: example mapping: 'data.exported_for_compliance' -> 'Data exported for compliance', 'kms.key_rotated' -> 'Key rotated'. Also add short reason column where applicable.
Marta: timestamp display: show local tz + relative time: 'Apr 07 2026, 14:12 CET — 2h ago'. Add a header toggle to force UTC.
Tess: keyboard / focus order: current tab flow is inconsistent. Desired: toggle -> region -> retention -> retention preview -> KMS -> save. Also make retention changes announce via aria-live polite with text: 'Retention set to 30 days'.
Ravi: will reorder DOM. We'll add aria-live on the preview region so SRs get numeric changes.
Omar: modal confirmation copy: change from 'Are you sure?' to 'Permanently remove data after [X days]? This cannot be undone.' Add secondary line: 'Consider exporting data before changing.' and a link.
Marta: for long retention customers we might show a cost hint: 'Longer retention increases storage costs' with a tooltip linking to pricing.
access-bot: keyboard checklist: ensure retention dropdown is operable via arrow keys and that the preview is reachable by keyboard. Ensure audit rows have role="button" and aria-expanded toggles on details.
ops-bot: staging deploy window 2026-04-10 03:00 UTC. Feature flag `compliance-retention-v2` required.
Tess: i'll update mock + copy and post a PR. @Ravi can you include the preview experiment behind the FF?
Ravi: yup will include and drop screenshots. tagging @Marta for a11y review once branch is ready.
Omar: filed follow-ups: UX-1542 (retention compact row + preview) and SEC-770 (kms badge copy + a11y). Thanks all :thumbsup:
